entries.en: Tellin' ya, man, ain't no way Flavio's this stupid...

entries.en: Nuh-uh, that's why he ain't comin'. But he'll send somebody.

entries.en: Jesus, hope so... I'm so fuckin' bored.
entries.ro: Doamne, sper... Sunt plictisit de moarte, pula mea.
